summary_points: Document is for Radar Level Instruments Specification.
Initials required on cover sheet only, other title block info on all pages.
Revisions are detailed in the body of the specification.
Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle allows for non-standard billing cycles.
Confidentiality clause restricts use and reproduction of information.
Material must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
Vendor must provide a spare parts list with prices and delivery dates.
Equipment must be inspected by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
Delivery schedule is strict, finalizing at the time of the final contract materialization.
Confidentiality agreement in place for information sharing.
The instrument is a Magnetic Float / Guided Wave Level Instrument for HTF Services.
It measures the level of a liquid in a still well with nitrogen and heat transfer fluid phases.
The transmitter outputs 4..20mA DC Loop Powered - HART or 600 Ohmios.
The instrument is housed in a cast aluminium enclosure with NEMA 4/4X protection.
Calibration can be done via keypad or HART Communicator.
